verdict.rationale: Docs mention a CLI ("the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account", "One command points a tool at a model and starts it") and cloud CLI subcommands like `wally account whoami`/`usage`, implying some CLI-driven model handling, and SDK-level download progress tracking (bytesDone, ETA, etc.) suggests download management exists under the hood. However, there is no explicit documentation of a search command or a general model list/manage CLI verb, and community reports (segfaults, install failures via homebrew, 'doesn't work on any of the methods I've tried') indicate real-world friction with the CLI tooling. Missing for 10: an explicit 'search models' CLI command, documented model list/remove/manage subcommands, and independent confirmation that CLI download/management works reliably.
